summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NPC/Bestiario system. All backend CRUD APIs (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) pass 100%. Frontend displays NPCs correctly with categories (Malignos: 26, Especiales: 4), structured data (CA, PG, velocidad, atributos, especiales, armas, acciones, reacciones), and NPC Editor modal with all tabs working.
critical_code_review_comments: NPC data structure is well-designed with separate arrays for especiales, armas, acciones, reacciones
Balrog de Moria correctly shows CA 19, PG 262, 22000 PX with all resistances/immunities
NPC Editor modal has all 7 tabs (Básico, Atributos, Defensa, Especiales, Armas, Acciones, Historia) working correctly
seed_data_creation: 30 NPCs loaded from PDFs (26 malignos, 4 especiales)
context_for_next_testing_agent: NPC/Bestiario system fully tested. Backend CRUD APIs work correctly. Frontend displays NPCs grouped by category with expandable details showing structured data. NPC Editor modal allows creating/editing NPCs with tabs for all data sections. Balrog de Moria is the most complex NPC with CA 19, 262 PG, resistances, immunities, special abilities, weapons, actions, and reactions.
